Take the maximum along sample dimensions.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TensorMax` |
| Search words | tensor, max, maximum, reduce, reduction |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor whose sample dimensions will be reduced |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Reduced tensor with the batch dimension preserved |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Reduction | Dimension | `dim` | Integer | `-1` |   | The run | Sample dimension to reduce, or -1 for all sample values. |
| Reduction | Keep Dimension | `keepdim` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Retain reduced sample dimensions with size one. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: TensorMax is a tensor graph reduction node; PipelineExecutor tensor reduction execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled and built as a tensor reduction layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
